text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (P1) — rate limiter cluster 'rategate-prod' seeing a 429/5xx spike across multiple tenants. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC-98765. Runbook: /ops/runbooks/rate-limit-spike.

elizabeth (oncall): Acked. I'm taking this — will triage impact and start mitigation. Ben, can you eyeball limiter heartbeats and quota-mapper?

ben: On it. pinging logs / metrics now.

elizabeth (oncall): quick checks: is this global or regionally scoped? any tenant tags in the alerts?

mike: Metrics quick view: across prod -- 429 rate rose from 0.4% to 9.8% in last 7m; 5xxs at ~3% concentrated in us-west and eu-west. p95 latency jumped from 90ms -> 420ms for rategate frontends.

ben: Looking at limiter heartbeats, we're missing heartbeat from quota-mapper-2 in infra namespace.
ben: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:05Z quota-mapper-2 ERROR tag-resolve failed for token tkn_***: mapped_quota=null
2026-03-15T03:12:06Z quota-mapper-2 WARN applied-default-quota=10
2026-03-15T03:12:07Z rategate front ERROR rate-limit exceeded for tenant: tenant-42 -> 429
```

carol: @elizabeth fyi PD shows ~240 pages in last 10m from autopage rule 'rategate-429-threshold'. Many of those came from the same tenant prefix.

elizabeth (oncall): So likely a mapping problem — tokens being mapped to a tiny default quota. If quota-mapper is returning null/misapplied tags, the limiter will clamp. Mitigation plan: 1) flip affected tenants to soft-mode (allow, log) 2) revert quota-mapper rollout (if any) 3) restart quota-mapper pods and flush prefix cache 4) monitor 429s and latency. Who can flip soft-mode quickly?

ben: I can flip soft-mode for the affected tenant group. Running command now:
```
# mark tenant-group as soft-fallback in rategate
curl -X POST https://admin.rategate/prod/tenants/tenant-group-42/soft-mode -d '{"soft":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

ben: Done — soft-mode enabled for tenant-group-42. This will let requests through but keep metrics.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by elizabeth (oncall). If not resolved in 10m, will escalate to the next on-call.

elizabeth (oncall): Rolling back quota-mapper canary (quota-mapper:v2 -> v1) to stop the bad mapping. ben, can you do the undo?

ben: Running:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/quota-mapper --to-revision=1
kubectl -n infra rollout status deployment/quota-mapper -w
```

ben: Rollback started. quota-mapper pods terminating/recreating.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation timer 09:28 remaining. (auto-escalate -> sevice-eng oncall)

carol: I'm joining — will run remap script to proactively fix already mis-mapped tokens. Share script and I'll execute.

ben: remap script (we use this to rebuild token->tenant index in redis):
```
# ./scripts/rebuild-quota-map --namespace infra --pattern "tenant-*" --dry-run
# when dry-run looks good: ./scripts/rebuild-quota-map --namespace infra --pattern "tenant-*"
```

carol: Running rebuild now (non-dry-run). ETA ~90s.

mike: Observability: 429 rate starting to decline in us-west, from 9.8% -> 4.2% over the last 2m. p95 latency down to 260ms.

ben: quota-mapper rollback succeeded; new pods (v1) healthy. Restarting rategate cache worker to ensure no stale kvs: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/rategate-cache`

carol: Rebuild script completed — remapped ~1.1k tokens that had null tag->quota, flushed redis prefix `quota_map_v2`.

mike: Post-mit metrics: overall 429s back to 0.6%, 5xxs back to 0.2%, p95 110ms. Customer-visible error volume dropped to baseline.

elizabeth (oncall): Great. I'm marking as mitigated. will keep this open for a 1h observation window then hand off. Ben takes primary ownership for postmortem/action items.

ben: Will create incident ticket INC-98765 in internal tracker, include timeline and commands. Starting root-cause triage: initial hypothesis — quota-mapper v2 had a validation edge-case where missing tenant tag produced default quota=10 instead of inheriting tenant policy.

carol: Adding follow-ups: add unit tests for tag resolution, add integration test that simulates missing tags, improve alerting to distinguish mapper-null vs real upstream overload.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved (ack cleared) — no further PD pages.

elizabeth (oncall): Final: Owner=ben, Severity=P1 mitigated -> postmortem required. Next steps: 1) Ben to file postmortem 2) Dev lead to revert/patch v2 and re-release with fix behind feature flag 3) Ops to add a guard on autopage to require >2 distinct tenants before mass page.

mike: quick note for support: impacted customers list compiled -> tenant-42, tenant-88, tenant-121. Outreach queued to CS.

ben: Created INC-98765-POST with full timeline + artifacts (links: /incidents/INC-98765, /ci/snapshots/3135798421). I'll assign owners for fixes.

elizabeth (oncall): Thanks everyone — great coordination. :white_check_mark: We'll add runbook step to fast-flip soft-mode and to check mapper heartbeats sooner.

carol: thumbs for follow-up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: This thread closed by elizabeth (oncall) at 2026-03-15T03:47:05Z.
